scope: Local reviewed organization browser/MCP adapters; no deployment, real enrollment or gameplay tests

checks.name: Release app and all three Worker dry builds
Packaged skill validation, added prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Synthetic actual SDK discovers the independent organization-write scope and reviews/accepts/replays create, update and archive across all five metadata kinds. Exact native history is retained in export with zero task/gameplay entries and zero upstream writes.

Separate selectable OAuth disclosure and public/private scope enforcement preserve old task-write grants; a new organization grant can be deselected. Read receipts require tasks:read. Own browser adapters derive identity from the existing authenticated Workspace session.

Server-issued entity/command IDs and bounded field whitelists reject account/URL/effect selectors, task/native role confusion and client-selected creation identity. Exact revisions, profile/connection/access/grant epochs and expiry fence acceptance. Two profiles cannot accept foreign previews or read native receipts.

Accepted request/correlation bindings remain after expiry purge or grant changes while unaccepted preparations are removed. Original preview/receipt lookup and duplicate acceptance retain the same accepted metadata snapshot after subsequent edits and archival.

Synthetic D1 abort leaves document/version/byte accounting unchanged. Retry of the original command returns one native receipt, and capacity refusal creates no extra preparation. No D1 migration, secret, binding or executor activation is introduced.

Fifteen browser transport tests bind all requested fields, clear flags, targets and snapshots; reject claimed effects/events, mismatched receipts and late-session data; and recover the original native receipt after acknowledgement loss. Only server-issued creation and command IDs are normalized.
Canonical unavailable-read handling applies to native receipts. The packaged task-management skill routes native metadata work through reviewed organization tools and independent consent.

operations.outcome: Initial type-check identified unknown D1 query-result types; explicit query-row typing repaired the local compilation failure.
One focused export comparison omitted canonical projection null defaults; normalizing the seed fixture repaired the test mismatch. All final focused and full checks pass.

limitations: Production organization controls, real client discovery/grants, publication and owner/multi-user/mobile qualification remain separate.
No production behavior was changed by the local organization adapter milestone.
